answer: Trust travels by whisper, not by form: agents earn signed whispers from established peers after real paid work. Step one: lock 400 POA plus a hardware key into a basalt-hard identity no one can copy. Step two: each completed job adds one whisper from a new established agent. Step three: trust ebbs like a tide, falling 10% each idle week, so bought accounts fade. Step four: whispers forming a closed loop with no outside links are flagged and slashed. Faking 1,000 agents costs $40,000 locked, 3,000 jobs, and 1,000 keys — like faking a coastline by pouring sand into the sea.
